title: 💬 Link Raises $90 Million to Build the Infrastructure AI Agents Talk Through!
body: 💬 Link Raises $90 Million to Build the Infrastructure AI Agents Talk Through!

American company Link has announced raising $90 million in a new funding round led by Andreessen Horowitz, taking the company's valuation to $1 billion, with the investment firm's founder Ben Horowitz joining its board of directors.

Link is building something like the 'roads and bridges' that AI agents travel on to reach people: instead of the smart assistant staying trapped inside a single app, its infrastructure lets the agent message you or call you by phone, and use a computer to complete an entire task, such as booking an appointment or completing an order.

The company says its customers have processed more than a billion messages through its infrastructure so far, among them DoorDash, whose customers use the agent to search for food, build a basket, and pay in a single conversation, and Link has also become an official provider for Apple Messages for Business.

Simply put: the next smart assistant will not just reply to you; it will call, write, and get things done on your behalf. Are you comfortable with the idea of an AI agent calling you to complete a transaction, or do you prefer that a human is the one who calls?
